description: This file implements logging output functions for the Zephyr RTOS, including timestamp formatting, color coding, message processing, and hex dump functionalities.

methods.name: level_to_rfc5424_severity
methods.description: Converts internal log level to RFC 5424 severity code.

methods.name: out_func
methods.description: Outputs a character to the log output, handling immediate mode and buffer management.

methods.name: cr_out_func
methods.description: Outputs a character with carriage return handling.

methods.name: print_formatted
methods.description: Formats and outputs a string to the log output.

methods.name: buffer_write
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the output using a specified output function.

methods.name: log_output_flush
methods.description: Flushes the log output buffer.

methods.name: is_leap_year
methods.description: Checks if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: get_YMD_from_seconds
methods.description: Converts seconds since epoch to year, month, day.

methods.name: timestamp_print
methods.description: Prints a timestamp in various formats based on flags.

methods.name: color_print
methods.description: Prints color codes if enabled.

methods.name: color_prefix
methods.description: Prints color prefix.

methods.name: color_postfix
methods.description: Prints color postfix.

methods.name: ids_print
methods.description: Prints message identifiers such as severity, thread ID, domain, source.

methods.name: newline_print
methods.description: Prints newline characters based on flags.

methods.name: hexdump_line_print
methods.description: Prints a line of hex dump.

methods.name: log_msg_hexdump
methods.description: Prints a hex dump of data.

methods.name: prefix_print
methods.description: Prints message prefix including severity, timestamp, and source info.

methods.name: postfix_print
methods.description: Prints message postfix including color reset and newline.

methods.name: log_output_process
methods.description: Processes and outputs a log message with timestamp, domain, source, and data.

methods.name: log_output_msg_process
methods.description: Processes a log message object and outputs it.

methods.name: log_output_dropped_process
methods.description: Outputs a message indicating dropped log messages.

methods.name: log_output_timestamp_freq_set
methods.description: Sets the timestamp frequency and divisor.

methods.name: log_output_timestamp_to_us
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to microseconds.
